messages:
incident-bot: Paging: continuous-batcher queue size in cluster us-west-2-runtime exceeded safe threshold (queue=~42k, growth-rate high). Multiple worker pods restarted with OOMs. Alert group: runtime-batcher-paging.

alex: seeing the alert, pulling logs now. any customer 5xxs?

trina: console shows latency spike on /v1/generate routes, p95 -> 12s, several retries. A few customer errors from api-gateway 502s.

samir: looking at node metrics — one node in the pool hit GPU OOM then kubelet restarted the pod. container crash log includes: "CUDA out of memory" and long GC pauses from our batch buffer.

oncall-bot: @channel incident created: RUNAWAY_BATCHER_QUEUE - Sev2, assignee alex, runbook: continuous-batcher-paging.md

alex: ran kubectl logs on runtime-batcher-7b9c, paste: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "batcher.py", line 412, in flush_batch
OOMError: CUDA out of memory```

jen: yikes. is this the known growth pattern where the batch size ramps and never flushes?

samir: looks like kv-cache growth + enqueued requests not being scheduled. the queue head isn't getting acks. possible deadlock in batching loop after a recent change to continuous-batcher backpressure logic.

michael: I just checked the rolling deploy from 2167390000 — we ship a change that touched batcher backpressure heuristics. I can rollback if we want.

trina: customers: two mid-market tenants reported timeouts and 1 production customer saw 502 spikes for ~3m. SRE dashboard flagged increased retry counts.

alex: immediate mitigation: scale up dedicated batcher replicas by +4 and temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 32 via feature flag. applying now.

k8s-bot: HorizontalPodAutoscaler scaled batcher-deployment from 6 -> 10 pods (policy: emergency-scale).

samir: adding a short-term prefix cache bypass to prevent huge KV accumulation. patching config in-flight.

jen: can we disable the backpressure change instead of rollback? that would be less disruptive. which config toggle controls it?

michael: flip feature flag `cb_backpressure_v2` -> false in runtime-config. I have the change ready.

alex: doing the flip now, pushing to k8s configmap and restarting pods gracefully.

trina: operator note: some pods are still failing with CUDA OOM on startup (they try to warm model). we should mark them unschedulable until new pods come up.

samir: temp workaround: add pod annotation to avoid warm-start on affected node type: `warm_start=false`. will push.

michael: rollback of the deploy prepared as fallback: `deploy rollback runtime-batcher 2167390000`. don't run unless we still see failures after flags.

alex: after scale + flag flip: queue started shrinking, p95 dropped to ~900ms after about 60s. OOMs stopped for new pods.

trina: customer impact timeline: 2167432109 - alert. 2167432175 - first 502 reports. 2167432400 - scale + flag flip initiated. 2167432500 - visible p95 improvement. 2167433600 - all nodes healthy.

oncall-bot: handoff to oncall: alex -> jen for monitoring and follow-up postmortem.

jen: taking handoff. I'll watch the cluster for the next 2 hours and start incident doc.

samir: quick note: logs show batcher loop enters a tight retry on acquire for `batch_lock` after the backpressure change — looks like we can reproduce with a local harness. I'll open a ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

michael: opened ENG-RUNTIME-876: reproduce & patch continuous-batcher backpressure deadlock. adding repro steps and logs.

jen: customer comms: triage said impacted customers were notified with an ETA. we should prepare a short summary for CS: cause (batcher backpressure regression), impact (latency / 502s for some tenants), mitigation (scale + feature flag), next steps (postmortem + fix).

alex: extra action: enable more verbose batcher metrics: queue.length, batch.wait_time_histogram, lock.acquire_time. setting now.

k8s-bot: Pod runtime-batcher-7b9c marked Unhealthy -> evicted; new pod runtime-batcher-8d4f started.

jen: will circle back in 30m with status. if any pods start OOMing again ping pager. :thumbsup:

samir: repro note in ticket: reproduce by saturating incoming requests with low tokens then flip backpressure flag; observed deadlock inside `acquire_batch` where condition notify missed. likely a missing notify after early return.

jen: postmortem owner assigned: jen. tentatively scheduling RCA for tomorrow 10am.

alex: thanks everyone. nice quick mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident RUNAWAY_BATCHER_QUEUE marked resolved at 2167440123 (mitigation: feature-flag flip + scale).

jen: closing loop — will add timelines, customer list, and follow-up actions in the incident doc.
